people.name: Mary
people.line: Mother of Jesus; wife of Joseph.

translations.web: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.
translations.bsb: Mary stayed with Elizabeth for about three months and then returned home.
translations.kjv: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.
translations.asv: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned unto her house.
